Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.96

- With three or fewer competing listings, a price over 200% of recent sales is now held for review before listing or raising it. Without enough sales to compare, prices of 100,000 gil or more are held.
- Sale history now comes from the marketboard itself, with Universalis used only when the game sends none.
